rules: No generic fonts for headings (No Inter/Roboto/Open Sans).
Headings (Size > 32px) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl+ (fluid). Never use text-7xl or above for Hero H1. Avoid jumps larger than 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading.
No pure black (#000000) or 50% gray (#808080). Tint greys slightly.
High contrast text ONLY. Never gray-on-gray for critical text.
Primary CTA gets the vibrant primary color, other buttons are subtle or outlined.
Avoid completely transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds with crisp 1px borders. Use subtle, nested radii (e.g., md on child, lg on parent).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header ONLY (Optical Clarity): bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain overlay across the entire site to remove digital flatness.

layouts.grid_strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol for Services/Stats. MODE A (Tetris Grid) for portfolio and features. Asymmetry and negative space preferred.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: use p-12, p-16, p-24 for section paddings.
layouts.hero: Kinetic Hero. Masked line-by-line text reveal on load using Framer Motion.
layouts.marquee: Slow Editorial Ribbon. Pale background with dark earthy/slate text. Massive gaps (gap-24).
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and paragraphs. Avoid default center-alignment for everything.

motion.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion.reveals: Scroll-triggered Framer Motion reveals (staggered fade up).
motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (slight lift -translate-y-1, color shift). Focus states must have high contrast rings.

3d_libraries.recommended: framer-motion 3D or react-spring-parallax for layered depth without massive overhead, or a Spline integration if the main agent can utilize it.

image_urls.description: Asian man using laptop - use as author/Rajeev professional headshot or About section image.
Digital marketing dashboard analytics - use for SEO & Digital Marketing service card.
Abstract AI node network - use for AI Automation service card or section background.
Professional using laptop - use for Web & Software Development service card.

component_styling.cards: Cardless, rectangular, flat with 1px border. Deep contrast on hover.
component_styling.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular, high contrast. Primary CTA (Contact/WhatsApp) stands out with hover interaction.
component_styling.forms: Customize Shadcn inputs to be large, airy, with subtle focus rings. Left-aligned labels.

Home.Hero: Kinetic typography, line-by-line reveal, 3D element (abstract network or floating shapes), CTA to consultation.
Home.Marquee: Slow editorial marquee showing skills (Web Dev, SEO, AI, WordPress) & Locations.
Home.Manifesto: Numbered chapters (1. Discover, 2. Build, 3. Scale) with asymmetrical layout.
Home.Services: Bento grid layout showcasing core services.
Home.Portfolio: Spotlight section with large imagery and clipped frames.
Home.Stats: Counters (12+ Years, 500+ Projects) built with Framer Motion.
Home.Pricing: High-conversion cards using 'Tracing Beam' or minimal 1px border styling.
Home.Footer: Massive typography for CTA, internal SEO links, clean dark/light contrast shift.

Location_Landing_Template.Hero: Service X in Location Y headline, specific CTA. Masked text reveal.
Location_Landing_Template.Content: SEO-rich localized content, process, local case studies.
Location_Landing_Template.FAQ: Accordion (Shadcn) with schema-ready questions. Clean 1px bottom border per item.
Location_Landing_Template.CTA: Sticky bottom or floating WhatsApp button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lenis, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body by updating tailwind.config.js fontFamily.
Use Shadcn UI for Accordion, Dialog, Forms, but strip the generic 'Vercel' styling to fit the premium bold art direction.
Never use purely centered generic Bootstrap-style layouts.
Ensure data-testid is present on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Build a floating WhatsApp button fixed at the bottom right corner of all pages.
Write SEO-friendly semantic HTML (header, nav, main, section, article, footer).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky nav.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
